Behavior Changes :

SD-138429 : Request Timer Action

In Request Timer Actions, Pause timer on hold is now enabled automatically when a stage uses a percentage-based trigger with DueBy Date or Response DueBy Time. On-hold time is excluded, so the timer action triggers at the set percentage of the request’s active working time. To include on-hold time, disable this option.

When an SLA is updated, the due by time calculation in History now shows OnHold Detection details, including how long the request was on hold.

  • SD-144581 : Performance notifications for high client latency and external antivirus software on the application server are now disabled by default. Notifications for external database backup tools remain enabled. You can enable or disable each notification through database configurations.
  • SD-143607 : Default action buttons in the Classic bot are now displayed in the application's configured language.
  • SD-143764 : Editing or reprocessing a service request with an inactive SLA removes the associated SLA, Due By Time, First Response Due By Time, and overdue status.
  • SD-145822 : The application's CSS files were updated as part of internal framework changes. These updates may cause UI alignment or display issues on customized pages. Modify any affected customizations to resolve the issues.

Framework Upgrade Information :

  • SD-144647 : Tomcat is now upgraded to version 9.0.123.
  • SD-142855 : jQuery validation library is updated to version 1.22.1.
  • SD-141878 : jQuery UI is updated to version 1.14.2.

Enhancements :

SDF-136820, SDF-139483 : Request Reprocess API

You can now use the Request Reprocess API to recalculate SLA-related values for existing requests when SLA configurations, holidays, or operational hours change.

The API recalculates due-by times, overdue status, and other SLA-related values based on the latest configurations.

You can reprocess a single request or up to 100 requests in a single API call. You can also use skip_parameters to exclude specific automations and validations, such as business rules, custom triggers, notification rules, and closure rules, during reprocessing.

To access the API, go to Admin > API > Documentation and select Reprocess Request or Reprocess Requests (Bulk).

We recommend reading the Request Reprocess API documentation thoroughly before using the API.

Request Data Migration

For sites that inherit configurations from another site, holidays configured for the parent site were not excluded from request time calculations. This issue (SD-139280) was fixed in build 15280.

Following the fix, a background migration now automatically identifies pending and closed requests affected in builds 15200 through 15270. The SLA, OLA, and assessment values of the requests are recalculated using Request Reprocess API.

Recommendations Before Applying the Patch

Review the following before applying the PPM for build 15270:

  1. The background migration is scheduled to start outside operational hours on the day the PPM is applied. To run it on another day or during the weekend, contact support before applying the PPM.
  2. By default, the migration runs for a maximum of five hours per day. If affected requests remain, the migration pauses and resumes the following day. Contact support to customize the maximum runtime.
  3. By default, only affected pending requests are reprocessed. To include completed requests.
SDF-138378 : Overdue Status Update via API

SLA and first-response SLA overdue statuses are now checked whenever a request is updated through the API, even if no SLA fields change. Overdue requests are now marked immediately, instead of waiting for the SLA escalation scheduler.

  • SDF-142164 : Administrators can now select a ChatGPT model under ChatGPT Integrations.
  • SDF-144153 : You can now edit the Redirect URL field when enabling Azure pre-authentication under Security Settings > Mobile.

Issues Fixed :

Vulnerability :
  • SD-144708 : Due to a stored XSS vulnerability, scripts in asset names execute when hovered over in the barcode generation list view.
Requests :
  • SD-144375 : Technicians can view request review emails, send review requests, and access reply templates via API for requests outside their scope.
  • SD-142778 : Viewing a request workflow’s execution history causes an internal error if a custom status used in that workflow has been deleted.
